instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lucide-react' for icons if not present.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' from Google Fonts for all headings.
Ensure ALL text has sufficient contrast against the dark background.
Do NOT use gradients for text, only for backgrounds or borders.
Implement the AI Chatbot as a floating widget that persists across pages.
Use the provided image URLs strictly for their assigned categories.
Ensure mobile responsiveness: stack bento grids to 1 column on mobile.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA compliance for text contrast.
